holm_status: The registered secondary comparator family uses Holm adjustment for secondary p-values. The materiality gates executed here are deterministic threshold comparisons on point estimates, so no p-value is generated in this pass and Holm adjustment therefore does not yet apply. No p-value is invented to fill the slot.
primary_comparator_selection_rule: chosen ex ante as primary comparator independently of observed RMSE
strongest_comparator_selection_rule: selected after observing baseline cross-sectional RMSE; lowest RMSE among the registered non-short-rate comparators on the same asset set; not used to choose the primary comparator
